name: house_XX_model_dataset.csv
description: One row per original source timestamp (all rows kept, including the final endpoint). Power columns are SIMULATED available PV potential in watts, not measured generation. No index column.

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.source: source Timestamp label, reformatted only; no timezone offset added; semantics unconfirmed

columns.name: Panel_Azimuth_rad
columns.source: scenario assumption: 180 deg south = pi; north = 0, clockwise positive

columns.name: Relative Humidity
columns.source: source value, unchanged; not used in the power model

columns.name: PV_Power_Generation_W
columns.source: simulated array DC after the 10 % aggregate DC loss, before AC conversion; no battery/load/MPPT curtailment

columns.name: PV_AC_Power_W
columns.source: simulated aggregate PV-only inverter AC output after conversion and clipping; excludes battery/grid and load

columns.name: Panel_STC_Power_W
columns.source: user-supplied Pmax per panel at STC

columns.name: Inverter_Unit_Count
columns.source: 1 for string/hybrid scenarios; one per panel for microinverter scenarios

columns.name: Inverter_AC_Rated_Power_W
columns.source: aggregate rating = units x per-unit AC rating

columns.name: Inverter_Nominal_Efficiency
columns.source: generic nominal PVWatts parameter (not instantaneous efficiency)

not_exported_note: POA irradiance and cell temperature are still computed internally; the inverter architecture is kept in simulation_config.json and metadata/run_metadata.json.
